title: AuthActions
description: Form-friendly auth handlers: resolves to { signInEmail, signUpEmail, signInSocial, signOut }, each (scope, event)-callable reading the enclosing form's FormData, bumping the session store, and applying the configured redirects

redirects.description: { afterSignIn?, afterSignOut? } paths (defaults to the project auth section's redirects)

provider.description: Default social provider id for signInSocial (a form field or the def may override)

resolve.description: The handler map: signInEmail / signUpEmail / signInSocial / signOut, wired via $ref (e.g. onsubmit: { "$ref": "auth.signInEmail" })
